changelog.summary: Credibility & Provenance Audit, PBKDF2 AES-256-GCM Key Derivation, Real ISO 18004 QR Encoder, Mobile Bottom Nav & Stepper UX, Full Hindi/Marathi UI, and IndexedDB Backup/Restore
changes: Audited all SKUs: restricted VERIFIED status strictly to entries backed by primary manufacturer leaflets/tables in the blueprint (Butalex MSD PDF & Carodyl verified table); marked all reseller-sourced or reference monographs as UNVERIFIED with lastReviewed: null.
Removed invented manufacturer names ('Indian Livestock Formulary Standard', etc.) and labeled reference entries honestly as 'Generic Reference Monograph (No Verified Indian Brand Leaflet)'.
Replaced localStorage AES key with PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, SHA-256 + random 16-byte salt) derived from a user session PIN/passphrase; removed deprecated escape/unescape.
Replaced pseudo-random QR pattern with a real scannable QR code generator (qrcode-generator + ISO/IEC 18004 encoder).

Redesigned mobile UX with a fixed Bottom Navigation Bar, 3-step guided Dosage workflow (1. Patient -> 2. Drug -> 3. Result), Result Card shown first with collapsible details, slim sticky header, and >=12px minimum font floor.
Unified all test suite counters to 16/16 across header, tabs, buttons, and i18n; fixed #printable-rx-area CSS typo; expanded Hindi and Marathi translations across all UI views.

changelog.summary: Stateless Node-Testable Engine (16 Live Test Vectors) & Section A–E Safety Overhaul
changes: Split stateless VetDoseEngine into src/dose_engine.js with 16 automated Node.js unit tests (src/run_engine_tests.js).

Enforced blank/zero/negative weight hard-blocks, strict allowedSpecies & allowedRoutes, species-specific maxDailyDose & maxDurationDays, two-phase 12h/24h fluids, 15% KCl (2 mEq/mL) injection volumes + 100 mL burette guard, 5-pt ruminant BCS + Shaeffer's heart-girth estimator, and poultry/aqua flock dosing.

legalRegulatoryNotes.topic: Student & Educational Scope vs. Statutory Law
legalRegulatoryNotes.explanation: This platform is built as a veterinary student learning and calculation decision-support aid. All regulatory citations (IVC Act 1984, Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945, NDPS Act 1985, CDSCO Section 26A notifications, FSSAI MRLs, and DPDP Rules 2025) are summarized from secondary academic and legal references and must be verified against official Gazette of India publications before any clinical reliance.

legalRegulatoryNotes.topic: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (Rule 65) vs. Veterinary Practice
legalRegulatoryNotes.explanation: Rule 65 governs licensed retail pharmacies (Forms 20/21) dispensing Schedule H, H1, and X drugs. Rule 65(10) requires veterinary prescriptions to be signed by a Registered Veterinary Practitioner and marked 'For animal treatment only'. Maintaining the 3-year Schedule H1 dispensing register is the retail chemist's statutory duty; veterinarians log in-clinic dispensing only when supplying medicines directly from clinic stock.

legalRegulatoryNotes.topic: Morphine & Veterinary Opioids — NDPS Act, 1985 vs. Schedule X
legalRegulatoryNotes.explanation: Morphine, Fentanyl, and Pethidine are governed under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985 and State NDPS Rules (requiring Special Narcotic / Recognized Medical Institution [RMI] licensing), distinct from Schedule X retail psychotropics.
